conditions.text: Recorded environment: app version 3.3.0 on iOS 18.4, device iPhone15,2 (all from Sentry contexts on the single event).

Push was in a healthy state on the event: deliverable, OS permission ALLOWED, provider registration REGISTERED; the profile was reported consistent. These are observed state, and the packet does not establish that they are required to reproduce.
Because only one event was considered, nothing here is known to vary versus be required; treat the whole context set as one observed configuration rather than a minimal repro.
Commit c33a666 "MEI-60: Weather widget on home" touches the same file as the culprit frame and is a lead worth checking when setting up a build to reproduce, not a confirmed cause.

missing_evidence_questions.text: Are there any other events with this signature, so we can tell which of the app version, OS version and device model actually matter rather than inferring from a single event?
Does the widget fail on every 204 from GET /api/weather, or only under some additional response or state condition not captured in the packet?
What does src/modules/weather/widget.vue line 19 do with an empty payload, and did commit c33a666 introduce or change that path?
Is reaching /home from a cold foreground required, or does the error also occur on re-entry or refresh of an already-loaded home screen?
Does the push and profile state on the event have any bearing on the weather request, or is it incidental context?

steps_prose.text: Bring the app to the foreground.
Have the backend call GET /api/weather return a 204 (no content) response; in the recorded event this is the call immediately preceding the failure.
The weather widget then fails while rendering: Error "Weather provider returned no data" from render at src/modules/weather/widget.vue line 19.

summary.text: A single reported event shows an Error "Weather provider returned no data" thrown in the weather widget's render function at src/modules/weather/widget.vue line 19, occurring on the home screen after GET /api/weather returns 204.
